title: Replace Flat-Flex Cable (FFC) at A-axis PCA (ClearLink tipper)
summary: Lock out/tag out the ClearLink tipper, access the A-axis PCA, remove the two FFC clamps (four M3 socket-head screws), unplug the old flat-flex cable (FFC), plug in the correct replacement FFC, and reinstall the clamps with the four M3 socket-head screws. Reinstall the station side panel if it was removed.
when_to_use: Use when the ClearLink tipper’s A-axis PCA flat-flex cable (FFC) needs replacement, following the manual’s replacement steps (including LOTO of the tipper and correct controller/FFC assembly selection).
not_for: Do not use if you cannot perform tipper lockout/tagout (LOTO) as required by the procedure.
Do not use to swap left/right ClearLink controller hardware/FFC assemblies interchangeably; the manual states they are not interchangeable due to different IP addresses.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Provide system-side guidance during the replacement and verify the correct controller/FFC assembly is being installed (left/right not interchangeable due to IP differences).
operator: Perform on-site physical actions including tipper LOTO and station side panel removal/FFC clamp work as applicable.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO of the tipper before working at the A-axis PCA.
Wear safety glasses and gloves during the procedure.
access_or_tools_needed: LOTO capability for the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2)

system_preconditions: Tipper is locked out/tagged out (LOTO) before accessing the A-axis PCA.
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout (page 2) referenced by the procedure

visual_references.description: Figure 7-14 diagram of the Flat-Flex Cable (FFC) assembly at the A-axis PCA, including the two FFC clamps and four M3 socket-head screws.

steps.title: Perform LOTO of the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely de-energized/locked out before any disassembly at the A-axis PCA.
steps.instruction: Lock out/tag out the tipper using the site’s Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure (referenced by the manual on page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in a locked out/tagged out state prior to removing the side panel or working at the A-axis PCA.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is active before any hardware removal begins.
steps.failure_condition: Hardware work begins without tipper LOTO.

actions.label: Apply tipper LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: If tipper LOTO cannot be applied, stop and escalate for further guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.14.1: REPLACEMENT step 1: "LOTO the tipper (see \"Operator Station Lockout/Tagout\" on page 2)."

steps.title: Remove the station side panel if necessary to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide physical access to the motor/A-axis PCA area for FFC clamp removal and FFC unplug/plug.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed (when necessary) to access the motor area.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panel removal is complete and the motor/A-axis PCA area is accessible.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel is not removed when required for access, or hardware is removed incorrectly.

actions.label: Remove side panel fasteners
actions.exact_action: use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the side panel cannot be removed as described, stop and escalate for further guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.14.1 step 2: "If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor."

steps.title: Remove the four M3 socket-head screws holding the two FFC clamps
steps.purpose: Release the old FFC from the A-axis PCA by removing the clamp fasteners.
steps.instruction: Starting at the A-axis PCA, remove the four (4) M3 socket-head screws holding the two (2) FFC clamps.
steps.expected_result: All four M3 socket-head screws are removed and the FFC clamps are released from the A-axis PCA.
steps.healthy_condition: The two FFC clamps are loosened/removed such that the old FFC can be unplugged.
steps.failure_condition: Any of the four M3 screws remain installed or clamps are not fully released.

actions.label: Identify A-axis PCA clamp screws
actions.exact_action: Starting at the A-axis PCA, remove the four (4) M3 socket-head screws holding the two (2) FFC clamps.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged or clamps cannot be resecured with the M3 socket-head screws, stop and escalate for further guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.14.1 step 3: "Starting at the A-axis PCA, remove the four (4) M3 socket-head screws holding the two (2) FFC clamps..."
Figure 7-14 shows the FFC clamps and M3 socket-head screws at the A-axis PCA.

steps.title: Unplug the old FFC from the A-axis PCA connection point
steps.purpose: Remove the defective/old flat-flex cable so the replacement can be installed.
steps.instruction: Unplug the old FFC from the A-axis PCA connection point.
steps.expected_result: Old FFC is fully unplugged from the A-axis PCA connection point.
steps.healthy_condition: FFC is removed without damaging the connector/clamps.
steps.failure_condition: FFC remains partially connected or cannot be unplugged.

actions.label: Unplug old FFC
actions.exact_action: Unplug the old FFC from the A-axis PCA connection point.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged, stop and escalate for further guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.14.1 step 4: "Unplug the old FFC from the A-axis PCA connection point."

steps.title: Plug in the new replacement FFC
steps.purpose: Install the correct replacement flat-flex cable into the A-axis PCA connection point.
steps.expected_result: New FFC is seated/connected at the A-axis PCA connection point.
steps.healthy_condition: FFC is properly connected such that clamps can be reinstalled.
steps.failure_condition: FFC does not seat/connect or cannot be clamped down.
stop_or_escalate_if: Do not install the wrong controller hardware: left and right ClearLink controllers have the same hardware but are not interchangeable because IP addresses differ; ensure the correct controller/FFC assembly is installed as applicable.
If the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged or clamps cannot be resecured with the M3 socket-head screws, stop and escalate for further guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: IMPORTANT note: "The hardware for the left and right ClearLink controllers are the same, but they are not interchangeable. The IP addresses are different, so the correct controller must be installed."

steps.title: Reinstall the FFC clamps and secure with the four M3 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Mechanically secure the new FFC to the A-axis PCA using the specified clamps and fasteners.
steps.instruction: Reinstall the FFC clamps and secure them using the M3 socket-head screws.
steps.expected_result: FFC clamps are reinstalled and secured with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws at the A-axis PCA.
steps.healthy_condition: All four M3 socket-head screws are installed and clamps hold the FFC in place.
steps.failure_condition: Any clamp screw is missing/not installed or clamps are not secured.

actions.label: Secure clamps with M3 screws
actions.exact_action: reinstall the FFC clamps using the M3 socket-head screws.

stop_or_escalate_if: If clamps cannot be resecured with the M3 socket-head screws, stop and escalate for further guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.14.1 step 6: "Plug in the new FFC and reinstall the FFC clamps using the M3 socket-head screws."

steps.title: Verify the FFC clamps are reinstalled with the four M3 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Confirm the mechanical installation matches the manual’s expected configuration before reassembly/return to service.
steps.instruction: Verify the FFC clamps are reinstalled with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws at the A-axis PCA.
steps.expected_result: Four M3 socket-head screws are present securing the two FFC clamps at the A-axis PCA.
steps.healthy_condition: Clamp hardware matches Figure 7-14: clamps and M3 screws are installed at the A-axis PCA connection point.
steps.failure_condition: Missing/loose screws or clamps not seated at the A-axis PCA.

actions.label: Visual verification of clamp screws
actions.exact_action: Verify the FFC clamps are reinstalled with the four M3 socket-head screws at the A-axis PCA.

stop_or_escalate_if: If verification fails (missing/incorrect clamp screw installation), stop and escalate for further guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 7-14 and replacement steps indicate the clamps are secured with four M3 socket-head screws at the A-axis PCA.

success_criteria: New FFC is plugged in at the A-axis PCA.
FFC is secured by the two FFC clamps using the four M3 socket-head screws.
Station side panel is reinstalled if it was removed.
healthy_conditions: FFC clamps are installed and secured with four M3 socket-head screws at the A-axis PCA.
Station side panel is reinstalled if removed for access.
failure_conditions: Wrong controller/FFC assembly installed (left/right ClearLink not interchangeable due to different IP addresses).
FFC clamps cannot be resecured with the M3 socket-head screws.
escalation_guidance: If the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged or clamps cannot be resecured with the M3 socket-head screws, stop and escalate for further guidance.
If there is any uncertainty about left vs right ClearLink controller/FFC assembly selection, stop and ensure the correct controller/FFC assembly is installed (IP addresses differ).
